# Libraries and packages

Load our custom functions for running LOESS+DE-SWAN and investigating simulation results.

```{R}
source("../null_simulations/loess_utils.R")
```

Load libraries.

```{R}
library(DEswan)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(gridExtra)
library(logr)
# optional for parallel processing
library(foreach)
library(doParallel)
```

# Figure 4

Load the sample data. 

```{R}
ipop_sample_data = read.csv("../ext/sample_info.csv")
```

Specify number of simulations and register parallel processing.

```{R}
nit = 2
doParallel::registerDoParallel(cores=2)
```

Run LOESS + DE-SWAN on the iPOP age distribution for $nit$ different random samples. In each case, the "expression levels" of the 8556 transcripts are simulated independently according to a uniform distribution. 

```{R}
transcriptomic_ipop = foreach(i=1:nit) %dopar%
{ 
  test_age_dist(ipop_sample_data$adjusted_age,
              npred = 8556,
              bucket = 20, 
              optimize_loess = F, 
              do_ipop = T,
              do_log = T,
              distribution = "standard_normal")
}

#save(transcriptomic_ipop,file="results/transcriptomic_ipop.rda")

doParallel::stopImplicitCluster()
```

Plot the waves of aging.

```{R}
plot_from_sim_list(transcriptomic_ipop,npred=8556) + 
  ylim(5000,7000) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 45, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 61, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text",x=48.5,y=5000,label="iPOP Tx Crest 1: 44") +
  annotate("text",x=57.5,y=5000,label="iPOP Tx Crest 2: 61") +
  ggtitle('Waves of Aging in Random "Transcriptomics"') +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(title = element_text(hjust=0.5),
        legend.position = "none")
ggsave("ipop_waves.jpeg",width=7,height=7,dpi=300)
```

# Do the same for protmeomcs

```{R}
ipop_protein_ages = read.csv("~/Desktop/sample_info_proteomics.csv")$adjusted_age

```

```{R}
nit = 50
doParallel::registerDoParallel(cores=5)
```

```{R}
proteomic_ipop = foreach(i=1:nit) %dopar%
{ 
  test_age_dist(ipop_protein_ages,
              npred = 303,
              bucket = 20, 
              optimize_loess = F, 
              do_ipop = T,
              do_log = T,
              distribution = "standard_normal")
}

#save(transcriptomic_ipop,file="results/transcriptomic_ipop.rda")

doParallel::stopImplicitCluster()
```

```{R}
plot_from_sim_list(proteomic_ipop,npred=303) + 
  ylim(170,260) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 44, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 57, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text",x=45,y=175,label="iPOP Proteomic Crest 1: 44") +
  annotate("text",x=56,y=175,label="iPOP Proteomic Crest 2: 57") +
  ggtitle('Waves of Aging in Random "Proteomics (n=303)"') +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(title = element_text(hjust=0.5),
        legend.position = "none")
```
